title: sharpen-draft — the draft of a sharpened issue body (issue-sharpening 01)
description: The Elephant's proposal for one issue: the complete proposed body, the criteria it moved to Post-deploy checks, one change row per criterion it touched, and the actions only a human can take. `draft_gate` checks the Input receipt and refuses a draft that changes, byte for byte, anything outside its change rows. _io is stamped by the server and is not part of this schema.

status.description: proposed: the draft is complete. cannot_sharpen: no change from the closed list makes every criterion verifiable without weakening a requirement or resolving one against a non-goal.

reason.description: Required when cannot_sharpen: why, in one to three sentences.

body.description: The complete proposed body, WITHOUT a `## Post-deploy checks` section; the gate assembles that section.

post_deploy_checks.description: One line each, no newline; [] when none.

criterion_ref.description: `AC<n>`: the 1-based index of the bullet under `## Acceptance criteria` in the ORIGINAL body, as criteria.md numbers it.

original.description: The bullet's text, exactly as in the original body, without its list marker (`- `, `- [ ] ` or `1.`).

proposed.description: The new bullet text, without its list marker (`- `, `- [ ] ` or `1.`), or null when the criterion moved to post_deploy_checks.

says.description: What is there, quoted or in one sentence.

human_actions.description: Actions only a human can take; they go in the comment, never the body. [] when none.
